P1-N001.title: Orchestrator v1: the process specification and the Claude Code plugin
P1-N001.outcome: A process specification and a Claude Code plugin run role-based agent sessions through the methodology on managed projects, at the least cost that does the job.

P1-N002.title: The repository bootstrapped and the founding plan written
P1-N002.outcome: The repository exists, is enrolled under the methodology, and holds the founding plan with its six chunks.

P1-N003.title: The orchestration process specification, version 1
P1-N003.outcome: The process specification under docs/process/ states the plan model, the Plan register, the dispatch loop, the roles, the profiles, the Cost log, auditing and observability.

P1-N004.title: The role contracts written, version 1
P1-N004.outcome: Six role contracts under .claude/agents/, each bound to a model tier, with the Orchestrator as single writer of the registers.

P1-N005.title: The plugin built and tried on this repository
P1-N005.outcome: The Claude Code plugin with the orchestrate and enroll skills, the form checker and the billing hook, tried in four trials on this repository.

P1-N006.title: The pilot on a real project, superseded by the service's migration and pilot

P1-N007.title: Cost reporting and the founding plan's close-out

P1-N008.outcome: A decision-ready proposal to methodology-tools for one generic capability: a checker that a project declares beside its custom type and that mtool audit form runs.

P1-N009.outcome: The plugin's tooling runs on the portfolio's declared stack, Node and TypeScript, and the Plan register grammar has one implementation that both repositories share.

P1-N010.outcome: The plugin's tooling runs on Node, and the Plan register grammar has one TypeScript implementation, proven by the journal_tail port.

P1-N011.outcome: A conformance corpus of fixtures with recorded expectations, and a generator that vendors the shared grammar unit into the service repository.

P1-N012.outcome: The form checker ported to TypeScript on the shared grammar unit, reproducing the Python checker's findings one for one.

P1-N013.outcome: The Python scripts retired, sync_agents ported, and every invocation site moved to the TypeScript tools.

P2-N001.title: Orchestration service: the MCP service and the web view
P2-N001.outcome: A service that Claude Code sessions call over MCP for plan state, coordination and owner questions, with a web view of the plan, and git as the only source of truth.

P2-N002.title: The service skeleton, and plan state read and updated through it
P2-N002.outcome: A deployed MCP service reads and validates the Plan register through a GitHub App, and a session updates plan state under an advisory lease.

P2-N007.title: The service repository bootstrapped and classified
P2-N007.outcome: The service repository exists with its Classification, its Node toolchain, its README and its Backlog.

P2-N008.outcome: A deployed MCP server on Lambda answers service_identity over HTTP with bearer-token auth, enlisted from a checked-in .mcp.json.

P2-N009.title: Plan-state read through the GitHub App
P2-N009.outcome: plan_read returns the coordinating repository's Plan register at a named ref through an installed GitHub App, with the commit SHA on every answer.

P2-N010.outcome: A session moves a node through a legal stage transition: it takes the lease, receives the exact edit, commits it, and the service confirms the commit carries it.

P2-N011.outcome: A session works with the service unreachable, and the enlistment documentation says how a repository enlists.

P2-N012.outcome: A merge to main in the service repository deploys the service, proves it against a real endpoint, and only then promotes it, with a red workflow on failure.

P2-N013.outcome: The Lambda alias assumptions the deploy relies on are verified against AWS documentation and recorded.

P2-N014.outcome: Pull-request checks build, lint and test without any deploy credential.

P2-N015.outcome: The lease table is selected by the invoked alias, and an unknown alias fails closed.

P2-N016.outcome: A merge to main deploys a version to the preprod alias, smoke-tests it, and promotes live only on a pass.

P2-N004.title: Topics for coordination between enlisted sessions

P2-N005.title: The task-pull loop: sessions claim tasks from the service

P2-N006.title: This repository migrates onto the service, then the pilot runs on methodology-tools

P2-N020.title: The task tools of the service

P2-N021.outcome: A signed-in owner sees the plan tree at one commit and drills to node and task pages, with the Project model's renderings beside them.

P3-N001.outcome: A model of each part of a project and what depends on it, plus the safeguards for longer runs of work without owner review.

P3-N002.title: The comprehension model: resources, edges and renderings

P3-N003.outcome: A catalogue of recurring risk classes, each carried from one instance to a check that reads the Risk register's class lines.
